item.title: Hundreds of children in England are prescribed weight-loss jabs
item.body: Hundreds of children in England are receiving prescriptions for GLP-1 medications, including some under 12, the Guardian has found. Experts stress the need for specialist supervision and long-term monitoring. The drugs were first developed for type 2 diabetes.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 💊 Hundreds of children in England are prescribed weight-loss jabs

Hundreds of children in England are receiving prescriptions for GLP-1 medications, including some under 12, the Guardian has found. Experts stress the need for specialist supervision and long-term monitoring. The drugs were first developed for type 2 diabetes.

Source: Guardian | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 14 November, 08:50
